title: DC-area forecast: Nice tonight. Sun and comfortable humidity the next few days
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly clear and comfortable this evening as breezes calm. Evening 70s cool off to overnight lows in the mid-50s to low 60s.

What's next? Plenty of sun and comfortable humidity stick around through Wednesday with highs in the 80s. Only a few storms possible late Wednesday, more so on Thursday as humidity returns.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Not a bad night to crack the windows for a bit. High pressure builds in and keeps our skies mostly clear. Very light winds from the west drop humidity even further (dew points in the 50s). Lows range from the mid-50s to low 60s. Confidence: High

Tomorrow (Monday): Although many of us head back to work and school, the weather won't be something to complain about. Mostly sunny with highs near 80 to 85, making for a beautiful day.

A light but steady breeze from the west-northwest helps lower humidity with dew points in the 50s. A few midday to mid-afternoon clouds could produce a brief sprinkle or shower. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: Another refreshing night with clear skies and calming breeze. Lows in the mid-50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Tuesday and Wednesday both look like winners with mostly to partly sunny skies and comfortable humidity. Tuesday highs aim for the low to mid-80s with dew points again in the 50s. Wednesday highs head for the mid-80s with slightly higher humidity– still on the low side– and perhaps a few storms late day. Both days are good outside days, overall. Enjoy, and maybe tackle some yard work. Lows both nights in the 60s. Confidence: Medium

A more typical August feel with higher humidity returns Thursday. A breeze from the south pushes highs into the mid- to upper 80s, while dew points climb to the mid-60s to near 70. The chance for showers or storms returns by afternoon or evening. Confidence: Low-Medium

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Sunshine, a comfy feel, and drier vibes ahead. Enjoy! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

The Chesapeake-Potomac Hurricane of 1933

A catastrophic 1933 hurricane devastated the Mid-Atlantic, bringing extreme flooding, a massive storm surge up the Potomac, and widespread destruction that reshaped parts of the Chesapeake Bay coastline.
